concerns.text: Tasks T004c and T024 introduce `confidence_rating` and `response_time` as predictors. This violates FR-004 (fixed effects: fixation, valence, CRT) and contradicts `plan.md` 'Notes on Removed Content' which explicitly removed WYSIATI metrics to prevent circularity. This is a scope expansion not authorized by the spec.

Task T006b forbids `velocity` or `dispersion` thresholds in config validation. However, FR-001 explicitly authorizes 'I-VT or I-DT' algorithms. I-DT inherently relies on dispersion thresholds. This task logic will incorrectly reject a valid, spec-authorized implementation path.

Task T028 mandates generating a 'Causal Framing Statement' unconditionally regardless of p-values. FR-006 requires framing findings as causal 'given the experimental design,' but Constitution Principle VII (Outcome-Neutral Validation) requires treating null results as informative. A rigid string output risks misrepresenting null findings as causal evidence, violating the outcome-neutral principle.

Task T032 requires reporting 'stability of the three-way interaction coefficient' during the threshold sweep. SC-003 (Success Criteria) only mandates measuring 'variation in the mean belief rating.' This adds an unverified metric to the success criteria, expanding the scope of the robustness check beyond the spec.

Task T004b extracts `belief_rating` in Phase 2 (Foundational). However, US1's Independent Test (spec.md) requires verifying 'fixation events are correctly timestamped and mapped to ROIs' as the primary output. Extracting the outcome variable in the foundational phase conflates the US1 data prep stream with the US2 outcome stream, violating the separation of concerns implied by the US1 test definition.
